extension.description: A control center for a developer's daily GitHub activities: PRs to review, your PRs, notifications, and a full PR page inside VSCode
extension.name: GitHub Control Center
welcome.toReview.signIn:
Sign in to GitHub to see pull requests waiting for your review.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:githubControlCenter.signIn)
welcome.toReview.empty: No pull requests waiting for your review. All clear. 🎉
welcome.reviewed.signIn:
Sign in to GitHub to see the pull requests you approved.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:githubControlCenter.signIn)
welcome.reviewed.empty: No approved pull requests. Approvals land here until new commits arrive or the pull request is merged.
welcome.mine.signIn:
Sign in to GitHub to see your open pull requests.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:githubControlCenter.signIn)
welcome.mine.empty: You have no open pull requests.
settings.badge.countToReview.description: Include the To Review view (PRs waiting for your review plus reviews needing your attention) in the activity bar badge count.
settings.badge.countMine.description: Include your own open PRs in the activity bar badge count.
settings.badge.countReviewed.description: Include the Reviewed view (PRs you approved that are still current) in the activity bar badge count. Off by default: only PRs actually waiting on you count. Has no effect while toReview.hideReviewed is on (hidden PRs are never counted).
settings.notifications.enabled.descripti: Show VSCode notifications for new review requests and for review outcomes (approved / changes requested) on your own PRs.
settings.mutedRepos.description: Entries to hide from both lists, the badge, and notifications: `owner/repo` mutes a repository, `owner` (or `owner/*`) mutes a whole organization. Tip: use the **GitHub Control Center: Manage Muted Repositories** command for a searchable picker.
settings.toReview.hideDrafts.description: Hide draft PRs from the To Review list, the badge, and notifications.
settings.toReview.hideReviewed.descripti: Hide open PRs you already reviewed (approved, stale, or changes requested) everywhere while they wait for a re-request: the Reviewed view disappears and no reviewed rows show in To Review.
settings.updateBranch.defaultMethod.desc: Method preselected for the Update branch action in the PR details panel.
settings.updateBranch.defaultMethod.REBA: Update with rebase (force-pushes the PR branch)
settings.files.layout.description: How a pull request's changed files are laid out under its row.
settings.files.layout.tree.label: tree
settings.files.layout.flat.label: flat
settings.files.layout.tree.description: Directory hierarchy with compacted single-child folders
settings.files.layout.flat.description: Flat file list with the directory shown next to each name
settings.ai.backend.description: Which local AI backend powers the AI features (PR brief). More backends may be added over time. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot override it.
settings.ai.backend.claude-code.label: Claude Code
settings.ai.backend.claude-code.descript: The Claude Code CLI in headless mode, using your existing Claude subscription
settings.ai.language.description: Language AI-generated content (the PR brief) is written in, regardless of the AI backend in use. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot inject it into the AI system prompt.
settings.ai.claude.command.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI. Used only when the AI backend is Claude Code. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot override it. AI features stay hidden when the binary is not found.
settings.ai.claude.model.description: Model passed to `claude --model`. Used only when the AI backend is Claude Code. Machine-scoped: a workspace cannot point it at an arbitrary value.
settings.ai.claude.model.sonnet.label: Sonnet
settings.ai.claude.model.haiku.label: Haiku
settings.ai.claude.model.opus.label: Opus
settings.ai.claude.model.default.label: CLI default
settings.ai.claude.model.sonnet.descript: Fast and balanced — recommended for PR briefs
settings.ai.claude.model.opus.descriptio: Most capable, slower and more expensive
settings.ai.claude.model.default.descrip: Whatever the Claude CLI is configured to use
